extraction.notes: No cards retained under the exclusion for district-only summer learning programs. The district's official AIG Summer Seminars materials explicitly describe the series as for students enrolled in Polk County Schools: https://moodle.polkschools.org/pluginfile.php/70/mod_page/content/16/AIG%20Summer%20Seminars%202024.pdf and https://polkschools.org/aig-summer-seminars/. The 2026 announcement offers the seminars to Advanced Learning and AIG students; no evidence of eligibility outside the district was found. The current enrichment page says Summer 2027: TBA. The 2026 Google registration form returned no readable text, so its eligibility questions could not be checked.
